step.cmd: Determine if additional fact-finding or clarification on any of the above points is required to make a decision:

ul.li: While fact-finding with the client, if claimant’s report information for the antedate period is also needed, obtain the information using the Claimant’s report: Original without paycoding or Claimant’s report: Original with paycoding checklist. Go to step 12. Claimant’s report: Original without paycoding Claimant’s report: Original with paycoding
If additional fact-finding is not required, go to step 14.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was reached during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was reached, go to step 13.
If the client was not reached or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter for additional fact-finding, go to Reassigning the WI to Level 2 . Reassigning the WI to Level 2

ul.li: Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
